deep_check_threshold.description: First-pass risk score (0-100) at which Kinguard escalates the redacted text to the cloud deep check.

family_alert_threshold.description: Risk score at which the family circle is alerted.

hybrid_cloud_model.description: Cloud fallback model for the hybrid first-pass screen.

deep_check_model.description: Cloud model for the expert double-check (redacted text only).

deep_check_fallback_model.description: Cloud model used when the deep-check model is overloaded.

escalate_low_confidence.description: Escalate low-confidence on-device verdicts even below the threshold.

max_input_chars.description: Max characters analysed per check (keeps on-device prompts under the token cap).
